title: Ubulungiswa Phakathi Kwabathengisi
intro: Umuntu othile wema phambi kwabantu abagcwele ukuheha kwenzuzo, ebabizela ekuthembekeni nasekulungeni ekusebenzelaneni kwabo. Le nceku ka-Allah yaxwayisa ngokunikeza isilinganiso esifushane nokuphambanisa izikali. Abantu benqaba ukulalela, besongela ngokuxosha lo muntu ezweni labo. Umhlaba ngokwawo wawuzovuka ukuze ubahlulele. Ubani lo muntu owayemele ubulungiswa phakathi kwabathengisi?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesithunywa kubantu ababegxile kakhulu kwezohwebo nakwezentengiselwano.
Abantu bami babenika isilinganiso esifushane lapho bekala izimpahla zabanye.
Bangisongela ngokungixosha ezweni uma ngiphikelela ekubabizeleni okholweni.
Ngikhunjulwa njengesikhulumi esinekhono kakhulu phakathi kwabaprofethi.
Abantu bami babanjwe ukuzamazama komhlaba okukhulu okwabashiya bengenampilo emakhaya abo.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
